labels: In a gym practice scene, the student's padded fists are raised beside the cheeks, elbows bent in front of the ribs and feet staggered on the mat.; 체육관 연습 장면에서 패딩 장갑 낀 두 주먹이 볼 옆에 올라가고 팔꿈치가 옆구리 앞에서 굽으며 발은 매트에 앞뒤로 놓인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: In a gym practice scene, the student's padded fists are raised beside the cheeks, elbows bent in front of the ribs and feet staggered on the mat.
aliases: 권투 가드의 손 위치
